name: ReActor face swap (second pass)
summary: Takes a finished picture and replaces the face with the approved reference, then restores it. It runs after generation rather than during it, so it works with any checkpoint family - including the ones an adapter cannot condition. What it cannot do is change pose, lighting, or anything but the face.
required_assets: The ComfyUI-ReActor custom node, which provides ReActor Fast Face Swap
inswapper_128.onnx in the ComfyUI models/insightface folder

The buffalo_l InsightFace models in models/insightface/models/buffalo_l. This one cannot be checked from here: the node loads it without naming it as an input, so nothing reports whether it is present until the first run fails.
A face restoration model such as codeformer-v0.1.0.pth in models/facerestore_models
